headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 14, 2026**
article:
The Detroit Tigers secured a shutout victory over the Cleveland Guardians, winning 3-0. Eduardo Valencia led the Tigers' offense with a home run and an RBI. In other action, the Cincinnati Reds edged out the Chicago White Sox in a thrilling 9-8 victory, with Eugenio Suárez leading the Reds' offense with a home run and 4 RBIs. The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing win over the Miami Marlins, with a final score of 13-1, thanks to Rafael Flores Jr.'s standout performance.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Matt Chapman has been transferred from the 10-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to an abdominal strain with the San Francisco Giants. Trevor McDonald also joins Chapman on the 60-day injured list with a right elbow strain. Garrett Whitlock has been placed on the 15-day injured list retroactive to August 10 with right elbow inflammation for the Boston Red Sox. The Detroit Tigers have placed James Outman on the 7-day injured list with a concussion and Riley Greene on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain. Endy Rodríguez has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to August 10 with left hip inflammation for the Pittsburgh Pirates.

The Baltimore Orioles acquired center fielder Harold Rivas from the Boston Red Sox in a trade, part of the August 3 Adley Rutschman deal. The Kansas City Royals also made a trade, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins.
